registers.label: Spare
lines: Whose image is this? Caesar's. Then give to God what is God's.
We bear God's image; to God we belong.
I am the Lord, and there is no other.
Sing to the Lord a new song; the Lord reigns.
The nations and their coins are not our king.
Declare God's glory among the peoples.
Come, let us worship the One who alone is Lord.
We give ourselves to God. Amen.

registers.label: Immersive
lines: Hold a coin in your hand and read the face stamped on it, then look at the face beside you, stamped with the image of God.
The Lord reigns; sing a new song.
Give Caesar his coins and his due, but give to God what bears God's likeness — give God yourself.
The Lord reigns; sing a new song.
For there is no other: not Cyrus, not Caesar, not any throne under heaven; the Lord forms the light and the dark.
The Lord reigns; sing a new song.
Declare his glory among the nations, his marvelous works among all the peoples.
The Lord reigns; sing a new song.
So come, you who bear his image, and worship.
The Lord reigns; sing a new song. Let the earth rejoice!

registers.label: Hybrid
lines: Whose image is on the coin? And whose image do you bear?
We belong to God; the Lord reigns.
I am the Lord, and there is no other.
We belong to God; the Lord reigns.
Give Caesar his coins; give God yourself.
We belong to God; the Lord reigns.
Come, let us sing the Lord a new song.
We give ourselves to God. Amen.
